note: Body has two lines: the first trims to exactly '))' (forcing the stripped-form fallback, since verbatim would misread it as its own closer), the second trims to exactly ')' (colliding with the stripped form's own closer). No multi-line form can hold both. See Sec 5.9.7. The String is wrapped in an Object (key 's') so it is not the bare document root: a bare String would fail ScalarRoot first, and the fixture must exercise exactly its named reason code (Sec 5.9.0).
